expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds milestone 1 (init / repo layout) with TODOs for the learner and does not hand over the code for later milestones (objects, trees, commits)
expectations.evidence: mygit.py has cmd_init with 'TODO 1...TODO 5' and 'raise NotImplementedError("cmd_init: fill in TODOs 1-5")'; no hash-object/write-tree/commit-tree code exists — only a dispatch table and a Repo/repo_find helper; PROGRESS.md marks milestones 2-7 'pending'

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Final answer ends with '**Checkpoint** (run this when done): mkdir lab && cd lab; python3 ../mygit.py init; git status' and 'Expected: Initialized empty Git repository in .../lab/.git followed by real git printing On branch main and No commits yet'

expectations.text: B3: States that a repository needs .git/objects, .git/refs (heads) and a HEAD file pointing at refs/heads/<branch>
expectations.evidence: 'Real git needs only three things to accept a repo: .git/objects/ ... .git/refs/heads/ ... and .git/HEAD (a one-line pointer telling git which branch is checked out — the literal text ref: refs/heads/main)'

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Only shell command run: 'python3 mygit.py; echo "---"; python3 mygit.py init' — no install commands; only files written are mygit.py and PROGRESS.md inside the project
